research_receipts.claim: A design token system needs interoperable names and typed values.
research_receipts.limitations: Token structure cannot prove visual token extraction quality.

research_receipts.claim: Color design tokens need explicit spaces, components, and alpha semantics.
research_receipts.limitations: Color syntax does not identify a source-specific system.

research_receipts.claim: Rendered proof must check minimum text contrast where applicable.
research_receipts.limitations: A contrast threshold does not prove aesthetic fidelity.

research_receipts.claim: Typeface metadata can support reproducible visual token extraction.
research_receipts.limitations: Font metadata cannot prove the rendered result matches the source.

disconfirmation.question: Can structure alone prove the visual token extraction result?

disconfirmation.disposition: Keep structure and visual token extraction behavior as separate gates.
